custom_statements.name: cve_record_search_vector_fn
custom_statements.up:
CREATE FUNCTION cve_record_search_vector(cve_json jsonb)
RETURNS tsvector
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $$
  SELECT
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(cve_json->'cveMetadata'->>'cveId', '')), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(
      (SELECT string_agg(c->>'title', ' ')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.cve_record_containers(cve_json)) AS c),
      ''
    )), 'A') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(
      (SELECT string_agg(d->>'value', ' ')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.cve_record_containers(cve_json)) AS c,
            jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'descriptions', '[]'::jsonb)) AS d),
      ''
    )), 'B') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(
      (SELECT string_agg(
         coalesce(a->>'packageName', '') || ' ' ||
         coalesce(a->>'product', '') || ' ' ||
         coalesce(a->>'vendor', ''),
         ' ')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.cve_record_affected(cve_json)) AS a),
      ''
    )), 'B') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(
      (SELECT string_agg(w->>'value', ' ')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.cve_record_containers(cve_json)) AS c,
            jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'workarounds', '[]'::jsonb)) AS w),
      ''
    )), 'C') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(
      (SELECT string_agg(g->>'value', ' ')
       FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.cve_record_containers(cve_json)) AS c,
            jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c->'configurations', '[]'::jsonb)) AS g),
      ''
    )), 'C') ||
    setweight(to_tsvector('simple', regexp_replace(cve_json::text, '[^a-zA-Z0-9 ]', ' ', 'g')), 'D')
$$

custom_statements.down: ALTER TABLE cve_records DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS search_vector
custom_statements.name: add_search_vector
custom_statements.up: ALTER TABLE cve_records ADD COLUMN search_vector tsvector GENERATED ALWAYS AS (cve_record_search_vector(coalesce(cve_json, '{}'::jsonb))) STORED

custom_statements.name: cve_record_cwe_ids_fn
custom_statements.up:
CREATE FUNCTION cve_record_cwe_ids(document jsonb)
RETURNS bigint[]
LANGUAGE sql
IMMUTABLE
PARALLEL SAFE
STRICT
AS $$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    array_agg(DISTINCT cwe_id ORDER BY cwe_id),
    ARRAY[]::bigint[]
  )
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(public.cve_record_containers(document)) AS container
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(
      container -> 'problemTypes',
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  ) AS problem_type
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    COALESCE(
      problem_type -> 'descriptions',
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  ) AS description
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT (regexp_match(description ->> 'cweId', '^CWE-([0-9]+)$'))[1]::bigint AS cwe_id
  ) AS extracted
  WHERE cwe_id IS NOT NULL;
$$;

custom_statements.down: ALTER TABLE cve_records DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS cwe_ids
custom_statements.name: add_cwe_ids
custom_statements.up: ALTER TABLE cve_records ADD COLUMN cwe_ids bigint[] GENERATED ALWAYS AS (cve_record_cwe_ids(cve_json)) STORED

custom_statements.name: add_cwe_ids_index_v3
custom_statements.up: CREATE INDEX cve_records_cwe_ids ON cve_records USING GIN (cwe_ids)
